Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first art-direction approval board for three original cartoon HUMAN restaurant spokespeople in a desktop 3D multi-agent restaurant debate game. Render a polished wide landscape concept illustration with a clean warm ivory studio backdrop, extremely clear full-body silhouettes, equal foot baseline, generous empty gutters. This is a character design reference, not a screenshot, no UI.
Primary request: precisely THREE full-body adult characters, left Sichuan restaurant proprietress, center Cantonese restaurant proprietor, right French restaurant executive chef. Each appears ONCE, front three-quarter view, relaxed slight A-pose, hands empty and visibly apart from torso, no crossing limbs. All the same coherent 3.5-head-tall proportion family: rounded cuboid heads, expressive enormous dark oval eyes with small ivory glints, separate thick movable eyebrows, tiny rounded nose, VERY CLEAR SMALL UNOBSCURED MOUTH, stubby four-digit hands (thumb and three fingers), short but usable limbs, broad simple shoes. Sculpted round-edged forms with soft matte ceramic / painted clay finish, subtle paperlike color softness, softly lit game-ready toy-like humans. Town-life warmth and playful graphic facial readability. Refined color blocking, 70 percent restrained base colors, 25 percent distinctive character hue, 5 percent bright accent. ORIGINAL characters, no existing IP, no photorealistic skin or realistic pores, no pixel artifacts.
LEFT: original lively Chinese woman about 38, confident welcoming arched eyebrows, rounded-square warm face, deep espresso-black hair in one distinct high rounded bun at the back/top, brick chili-red cropped jacket #B94F45 with three small ivory closures, ivory shirt #F5ECDC, full-length high-waist dark aubergine trousers, ochre waist apron #D2A44C ending mid-thigh with one asymmetric pocket, simple aubergine shoes. Petite sturdy energetic silhouette. Small stylized chili enamel pin on upper jacket. Mouth visible and closed in a slight smile.
CENTER: original Chinese man about 46, gentle shrewd smile and calm eyebrows, rounder compact silhouette, short smooth dark side-parted hair with a tiny grey patch at one temple, NO beard or moustache, jade-green stand-collar short-sleeve shirt #447D6B with clean ivory placket, dark ink trousers #29343A, long cream waist apron ending above knees with one jade pocket and a subtle tea-leaf emblem, dark shoes. Poised calm welcoming posture. Mouth fully clear.
RIGHT: original French restaurant male executive chef about 40, taller softly tapered silhouette, cream chef jacket with exactly two columns of small dark buttons, plum-purple scarf #75628E tied close at neck, plum trousers, simple low white chef cap with a gently squared rounded top, visible short chestnut hair, NO moustache or beard, clear expressive brows and a poised amused slight smile. Pale butter accent #DCCB87 only on a small collar pin. Clean white apron ending mid-thigh. Fully visible mouth. This is a FRENCH CUISINE chef, absolutely no wizard hat, magic, wand or fantasy costume.
Lighting: identical neutral soft key and subtle contact shadows, no dramatic colored light, no deep gloss. Consistent scale/material and shared art direction. At bottom add three small UNLABELLED groups of 3-4 color chips. No text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no scenery, no handheld props, no duplicate characters. Their culinary identity comes from costume and silhouette rather than ethnic caricature. Highest practical image resolution.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: multi-view character design and expression reference sheet. Input 1 is the three-character style/identity master. Produce one high-resolution LANDSCAPE 3:2 board, ivory studio background, generous empty gutters. No typography, no logos, no lettering. The board contains ONE character repeated coherently, not new designs.
Upper 65 percent: exactly FOUR full-body views in this order: TRUE FRONT looking toward viewer; FRONT THREE-QUARTER turned 45 degrees toward page right; TRUE BACK (face completely invisible); TRUE PROFILE looking LEFT toward page left (only one eye visible). The last view MUST FACE PAGE LEFT, unlike the three-quarter view. All feet on same baseline, identical body scale and height, identical relaxed A-pose, hands visibly separated from waist. One identical face, hairstyle, costume and proportions rotated across all four views; no outfit or pocket mirroring. At least a palm-width gap between figures. Neutral small CLOSED mouth. Entire feet and hair/hat in frame. No handheld props.
Lower 35 percent: exactly EIGHT same-scale front-angle HEAD portraits of that one character, clear separation. Left to right: neutral attentive, friendly welcome, confidently amused, curious, skeptical side-eye (one raised eyebrow), surprised small O mouth, embarrassed crooked smile, delighted open laugh. Keep hair/nose/age/clothes fixed. Expression through eyes/brows/mouth, no symbols. Soft round forms and matte materials, refined solid color blocking, clear cartoon faces. No photographic skin. Preserve identity from the supplied master carefully. These are concept design references, not finished rigs or texture maps.
Use ONLY the LEFT WOMAN from input 1. Warm energetic Sichuan restaurant proprietress. EXACT dark high bun with small blue tie, wide dark eyes, warm face, brick-red cropped jacket with three ivory closures and small chili pin on wearer's left chest, ivory shirt, ochre waist apron with pocket on wearer's right, dark aubergine trousers and plum shoes. Rear apron design: thin tied waist ribbon with a short knot, apron fabric ONLY across FRONT and SIDES, back of aubergine trousers visible. Do not put a large back apron panel. Do not swap or duplicate side views. Preserve body, face and clothes from master.
